name: anno
description: Preview, edit, and annotate local HTML, then hand the complete review to the current agent for generation and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and annotate local HTML with an agent.
interface.longDescription: Open a local HTML artifact in Anno, edit text and structured formatting in place, capture free-form annotations, then return the complete review session to the current agent so it can generate, validate, register, and deliver the final standalone HTML file.
defaultPrompt: Open this HTML in Anno and generate the final file.
Continue the Anno review session and resolve pending annotations.
